body:
## What's Changed
* docs: 0.9.0 changelog + blog posts by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3189
* fix(coding-agents): seed the actual harness, not the "opencode" default (#3247, #3248) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3266
* fix(docker): repair PGroonga Compose image by @JiehoonKwak in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3316
* fix(engine): stop concurrent bank deletes from deadlocking on vector-index DDL by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3245
* fix(coding-agents): fall back from filesystem-root worktrees by @koriyoshi2041 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3286
* fix(worker): serialise graph_maintenance per bank at claim time by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3235
* fix(llm): forward extra body to Codex requests by @koriyoshi2041 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3305
* fix(api): knowledge-base search 500s on non-native text-search backends (#3268) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3318
* test(ci): gate every build on hermes-agent@main co-installability by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3265
* fix(config): validate bank config value types and stop them wedging tasks (#3218) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3319
* test(bank-template): round-trip every exportable field through export+import by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3324
* perf(reflect): drop retrieval plumbing from reflect tool results by @JoshFunnell in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3310
* feat(bank-template): make every bank config field export+importable by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3332
* fix(structured-doc): add TableBlock to fix markdown table rendering by @dragonkid in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3289
* feat(reflect): resolve entity names on reflect sub-recalls by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3334
* fix(api): gate knowledge-base routes through the operation validator (#3312) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3331
* fix(coding-agents): write back only the new turns (append + idempotent retain) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3336
* Pin embed to the metapackage release by @koriyoshi2041 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3261
* feat(transfer): carry Knowledge Pages tree + regenerate mental-model search state on import (#3308, #3323) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3330
* fix(api): return 400 for malformed UUID on GET /entities/{id} and /memories/{id}/history by @Alan5168 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3260
* fix(control-plane): surface direct request failures by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3333
* fix(api): add a DB-free liveness probe so a slow database stops restarting pods by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3337
* fix(coding-agents,ci): drop the periodic re-sync; stop running doc examples for integration changes by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3341
* fix(coding-agents): bound transcript reads so an oversized session still retains (#3292) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3345
* fix(ollama): make native think configurable via extra_body by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3344
* feat(llm): xai-oauth provider — run the engine's LLM lanes on a flat-rate SuperGrok subscription (device-code OAuth, no API key), production-hardened by @JoshFunnell in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3272
* fix(reflect): provide the current date for temporal reasoning by @koriyoshi2041 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3287
* fix(transfer): reject a wrong import zip with a 400 that names the fix by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3339

* docs(config): name LM Studio/Ollama/Volcano for LLM_STRICT_SCHEMA by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3348
* fix(search): use PGroonga for Knowledge Pages by @JiehoonKwak in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3335
* fix(engine): normalize whitespace in candidate entity names at resolution intake by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3338
* fix(gemini): fail fast on deterministic 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT (#3256) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3347
